newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real rises 0.01 pct in calm trading.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real rises 0.01 pct in calm trading.

text.p: Brazil's real rose a slight 0.01 percent to close at 1.0275 against the dollar in calm trading in the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a Wednesday surplus of $40 million.
In the interbank forex floating rate market, the real dropped 0.01 percent to close at 1.0315 to the dollar.
In the illegal parallel market, the real ended flat at 1.095 per greenback, traders said.
